model: Claude Code agent mode, fresh subagent

steps.start: a point on the natural boundary of Windermere Lake on the easterly shore thereof at the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Windermere Creek on the right bank thereof
steps.quote: Commencing at a point on the natural boundary of Windermere Lake on the easterly shore thereof at the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Windermere Creek on the right bank thereof

steps.until: the south boundary of D.L.8, Kootenay Land District
steps.quote: thence in a general southerly direction along the natural boundary of Windermere Lake on the easterly shore thereof to the south boundary of D.L.8, Kootenay Land District

steps.until: the southerly boundary of Block A, D.L.108
steps.quote: thence easterly and northerly along the southerly and easterly boundaries of D.L.8 to the southerly boundary of Block A, D.L.108

steps.until: the easterly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way
steps.quote: thence westerly along the southerly boundary of Block A, D.L.108 to the easterly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way

steps.feature: Highway 93/95 right of way, Swansea Road right of way and again Highway 93/95 right of way
steps.until: the point of intersection with a westerly prolongation of the northerly boundary of D.L.9001
steps.quote: thence northerly along the easterly boundaries of Highway 93/95 right of way, Swansea Road right of way and again Highway 93/95 right of way to the point of intersection with a westerly prolongation of the northerly boundary of D.L.9001

steps.feature: the said prolongation, the southerly boundary of the adjacent unnamed road right of way and a prolongation thereof
steps.until: the natural boundary of Windermere River on the right bank thereof
steps.quote: thence westerly along the said prolongation, the southerly boundary of the adjacent unnamed road right of way and a prolongation thereof to the natural boundary of Windermere River on the right bank thereof

steps.until: the intersection with the natural boundary of Windermere Lake on the easterly shore thereof
steps.quote: thence in a general southerly direction along the natural boundary of Windermere River on the right bank thereof to the intersection with the natural boundary of Windermere Lake on the easterly shore thereof
thence in a southerly direction along the natural boundary of Windermere Lake on the easterly shore thereof to the point of commencement
